           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY id) as line_num

warehouse_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, l.aisle, l.position, i.location_id,
           p.purchased, i.qty as inv_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) as rn
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
inventory_ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id, aisle, position, location_id, purchased, inv_qty, rn,
           SUM(inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn) as running_total
    FROM warehouse_inventory
),
allocations AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.product_id,
        ir.aisle,
        ir.position,
        ir.inv_qty as qty,
        ir.rn as pick_order,
        ir.purchased,
        CASE 
            WHEN pt.total_needed >= ir.running_total THEN ir.inv_qty
            ELSE pt.total_needed - LAG(ir.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY pt.product_id ORDER BY ir.rn)

    JOIN inventory_ranked ir ON pt.product_id = ir.product_id
    WHERE ir.rn <= (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_ranked ir2 WHERE ir2.product_id = pt.product_id)
)

order_cumulative AS (

    FROM order_lines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id as purchase_id,
        p.purchased,
        p.product_id,
        i.qty as inventory_qty,
        l.id as location_id,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.product_id 
            ORDER BY p.purchased, p.qty, i.location_id
        ) as rn,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.product_id 
            ORDER BY p.purchased, p.qty, i.location_id
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) as cum_inv
    FROM purchases p
    JOIN inventory i ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
    AND p.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = 423)
),
picking_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        ir.product_id,
        ir.location_id,
        ir.aisle,
        ir.position,
        ir.inventory_qty,
        ir.rn,
        co.cum_qty,
        ir.cum_inv,
        LAG(ir.cum_inv) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.product_id ORDER BY ir.rn) as prev_cum_inv,
        ir.cum_inv - LAG(ir.cum_inv) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.product_id ORDER BY ir.rn) as qty_in_location,
        CASE 
            WHEN ir.rn = 1 THEN
                CASE WHEN ir.inventory_qty <= co.cum_qty THEN ir.inventory_qty ELSE 0 END
            ELSE
                CASE 
                    WHEN ir.cum_inv <= co.cum_qty THEN 0
                    ELSE LEAST(co.cum_qty - LAG(ir.cum_inv) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.product_id ORDER BY ir.rn) + ir.inventory_qty, 
                             ir.inventory_qty)
                END
        END as qty_to_pick
    FROM inventory_sorted ir
    JOIN order_cumulative co ON ir.product_id = co.product_id
)
